biography: Thiago Riberi, a name synonymous with raw aggression and unwavering determination in the Brazilian motorsport scene, hails from the bustling favelas of São Paulo. His journey began not on a pristine racetrack, but on the chaotic streets, dodging traffic and honing his reflexes delivering pizza on a battered scooter. The roar of engines always captivated him, a stark contrast to the quiet poverty he knew. One sweltering afternoon, while delivering an order to the Interlagos circuit, he snuck a peek through the fence, mesmerized by the flashing colors and the symphony of engines. That moment ignited a fire, a burning desire to be more than just a spectator. His break came unexpectedly. A local Copa Montana team, short on funds, held open tryouts. Riberi, with his natural talent and fearless driving style, stunned everyone, securing a spot on the team. He quickly rose through the ranks, his aggressive maneuvers and relentless pursuit of victory earning him both admiration and controversy. Now, at 33, Riberi is at the peak of his career, a force to be reckoned with, his name etched in the annals of Brazilian motorsport.
drivingStyle: Riberi's driving style is a high-risk, high-reward affair. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and aggressive corner entries, often pushing his car, and his competitors, to the absolute limit. Tire management isn't his forte; he prefers all-out attack, sacrificing tire life for immediate gains. Under pressure, Riberi thrives. The tighter the race, the more fiercely he fights, often pulling off improbable overtakes in the dying laps. He's a pure racer, driven by instinct and an insatiable hunger for victory.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Vargas
rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision during the 2018 Copa Montana championship decider. Vargas accused Riberi of deliberately wrecking him, fueling a bitter rivalry both on and off the track.

rivalries.name: Isabela Monteiro
rivalries.reason: A clash of personalities and driving styles. Monteiro, known for her calculated and precise approach, views Riberi's aggression as reckless and dangerous, leading to frequent on-track altercations.

rivalries.name: Marco Silva
rivalries.reason: A rising star challenging Riberi's dominance. Silva's youthful exuberance and raw speed pose a significant threat, creating a dynamic rivalry fueled by ambition and the pursuit of championship glory.

quirks: Always wears the same faded 'Senna Sempre' t-shirt under his racing suit, a tribute to his idol.
Listens to a specific playlist of Brazilian samba music on repeat before every race to calm his nerves.
Carries a small, worn picture of his grandmother in his helmet, a reminder of his humble beginnings and a source of strength.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about playing nice. It's about pushing yourself, your car, and your rivals to the breaking point. Only then do you truly know who you are."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2020 Copa Montana championship after a season-long battle with Ricardo Vargas. He clinched the title in the final race with a daring last-lap overtake, solidifying his status as a Brazilian motorsport icon.
careerLowPoint: Suffering a season-ending injury in 2016 after a high-speed crash at Curitiba. The accident threatened to derail his career, forcing him to undergo months of rehabilitation and questioning his future in racing.
